messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: Deployment 2026-03-15T02:13Z (canary) - 5xx rate up 11% -> 27% over baseline in /generate. Service: inference-api. Auto-canary-swap failed to converge. Paging @sre_maya and @eng_liam :rotating_light:

sre_maya: seeing the spike in logs now. root cause unclear, partially 502s from model-runtime container. Canary was a rollforward of quantized kernels (q8).

eng_liam: I pushed the q8 kernel change in the canary at 02:08. Initial smoke looked fine locally. Repro steps?

sre_maya: load shows increased tail latency followed by connection resets to model runtime. snippet from proxy: ``` ERROR upstream_reset: connection closed by peer after 120s ```

eng_liam: that suggests the runtime is OOM-ing or hitting a GC. Checking node metrics. Jumping into the pod logs.

infra-bot: kubectl get pods -n inference | grep canary -> inference-canary-5fd7c Running 2/2 10% CPU 4.8Gi/8Gi

eng_liam: logs show repeated `AssertionError: kv_cache corruption` in runtime. That matches a vector we saw with the new kernel when sequence lengths > 2048. Our canary traffic included some long completions.

prod_lead_jordan: customer-ops, any customer-facing errors yet? Nina?

customer_ops_nina: Support ticket stream: two paying customers reported generation timeouts and a handful of API 502s since 02:14. Not yet widespread but looks like high-value users hitting longer prompts. 

sre_maya: mitigation plan: 1) flip feature flag to stop routing traffic to canary (kill-switch). 2) scale down canary pods. 3) start rollback if kill-switch doesn't fully recover within 5m. Agree?

eng_liam: agreed. I can flip the rollout flag: `ffctl set inference.canary_enabled false --env=prod`

eng_liam: done. Routing update pushed. Cloud LB reports drained weight from canary to stable. 

oncall-bot: ACTION: Feature flag change detected by deployment-watcher: inference.canary_enabled = false by eng_liam at 02:17Z

sre_maya: metrics: 5xx rate dropped from 27% -> 9% in ~60s. Latency tail improving. Keep monitoring for error replay.

customer_ops_nina: still seeing two open tickets with timeouts; I will DM support to mark as mitigated and set expectation that we rolled back canary.

eng_liam: despite the flag flip, one canary pod still throws the kv_cache error before shutting down. I'll scale the replica set to 0: `kubectl scale rs inference-canary --replicas=0 -n inference`

infra-bot: scaling rs/inference-canary to 0 replicas.

sre_maya: scaling completed, proxy shows no active canary endpoints. 5xx steady at 1.2% now. Looks good.

prod_lead_jordan: quick impact assessment: affected subset = canary traffic ~2.5% of prod weight; errors concentrated on long prompt paths (batch size 1, seq > 2k). Rough estimate: ~1200 requests affected, ~25 unique customers, 3 enterprise-level timeouts. No data exfiltration, no auth failures. Marking initial severity: SEV3 -> moving to SEV2 due to enterprise hits? opinions?

sre_maya: I think SEV3 is fine given limited blast radius; enterprise hits were quick timeouts and all recovered with rollback. We'll flag for follow-up postmortem.

eng_liam: root cause hypothesis: q8 kernel introduced an edge-case in KV cache handling for long sequences. The regression wasn't triggered by unit tests; our smoke tests capped sequences at 1024. We'll add stress tests with longer sequences to CI.

customer_ops_nina: Customer comms: I prepared a short note: "We observed intermittent generation timeouts for long prompts caused by a canary rollout; mitigation completed by removing canary traffic. If you still see errors, reply and we'll escalate." I'll send to affected customers after you confirm.

prod_lead_jordan: confirmed. send now. Ops: create a short incident ticket and assign to eng_liam + sre_maya for postmortem.

sre_maya: creating incident-XXXX ticket now, linking logs and perf graphs.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-20260315-1972 assigned to eng_liam, sre_maya. Severity: SEV3. Handoff deadline 06:00Z if not resolved.

eng_liam: I'll provision a hotfix branch to revert the kernel change and run a canary in staging with longer prompts. Plan: revert->bench->staging-canary->prod-rollout with stricter seq gating. ETA for PR and tests ~4 hours.

sre_maya: will monitor and schedule handoff to daytime oncall @eng-oncall for 06:00Z. If anything re-raises, page immediately.

customer_ops_nina: I updated the two open tickets as mitigated and included the rollback note. No customer asks for credits yet.

prod_lead_jordan: thanks all. Follow-up tasks: 1) add long-seq regression tests to CI 2) add pre-rollout smoke test to canary that simulates seqs up to 4096 3) postmortem doc in /docs/incidents with timeline. Assigning owners: eng_liam (fix and tests), sre_maya (postmortem + monitoring alerts), nina (customer follow-ups).

sre_maya: copying timelines & logs into the incident ticket. closing thread for now; will reopen if anomalies reappear. :white_check_mark:

eng_liam: thanks. I'll ping when PR is ready.

oncall-bot: THREAD CLOSED: 02:31Z - All mitigations executed; monitoring watch resumed.
